name: Dinkum Internet
summary: Melbourne residential dialup ISP (later DCG Retail); bought by Swindells/Monching 2002 as half of DCG, axed Sep 2004 when DCG renamed ispOne.

events.details: Residential ISP; acquired 2002 by Swindells/Monching with Prime Internet to form Data Consulting Group (as DCG Retail). Small base: management, friends/family and one dealer partner (AKA, ~100 dealers).

refs.label: iTnews (Feb 2004): DCG formed by acquiring Dinkum Internet (DCG Retail) and Prime Internet (DCG Business) in 2002

events.details: Retail operation axed (dormant ~1 year); DCG renamed itself ispOne to focus on wholesale (~40 ISPs).

refs.label: ARN (Sep 2004): DCG axes retail Dinkum Internet, renames ispOne

events.details: Possible pre-2002 owner: a LANcare staffer profile lists 'Dinkum Internet (ISP for residential areas)' among LANcare subsidiaries - unverified, needs corroboration.
